name: volume_spike_exhaustion_fade
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second bar shows a volume spike (4x+ the recent 5-minute average) but the price body is less than 30% of the bar's high-low range (a doji or spinning-top candle), it signals that a large institutional VWAP/TWAP algo or a momentum cascade hit the order book but was immediately absorbed by opposing resting limit orders at that level. The aggressive flow exhausts itself — buyers who chased up or sellers who dumped have completed their program — and the residual imbalance unwinds as market makers and short-gamma desks fade the move within the next 15-90 seconds. The key is the combination: high volume confirms real participation, doji body confirms the participants failed to move price, making imminent reversion highly probable.
core_signal_oneliner: Volume spike 4x+ 5-minute average on a doji candle (body < 30% of range), signaling institutional flow absorbed without directional follow-through
